notes.title: School Fighter is here!
notes.content:
School Fighter Launch!

We’re excited to announce that School Fighter has just launched on Steam and is fully ready to play!

Alongside the release, we’ve also published the #DayOnePatch update, fixing a few issues discovered in the first hours after launch.

Patch 1.01:


 Fixed an issue with certain Steam achievements not being properly registered,
 Made minor adjustments to the "level up" screen,
 Added a few new soundtracks,
 Improved balance in some boss fights.


Lastly, we have a small request for you! Share your feedback with us at contact@sheep-games.com and take part in the active development of School Fighter!

notes.title: First Gameplay!
notes.content:
It's here! The first sneak peek of our gameplay. We're super excited to share it with you. 

The video showcases:

 different game events, like zombie mode,
 basic combat mechanics,
 a variety of enemies,
 special boss fights,
 school shop mechanics.
